---
title: "Data Wrangling"
format: html
---

### Store data from .csv
```{r}
library(readr)

# Load hospitals_2026_11_11 data
hospitals_2026_11_11 <- read_csv("data/hospitals_2026-11-11.csv")

```


### Adding latitude/longitude coordinates
```{r}
library(tidygeocoder)
library(dplyr)

# Census
geo1 <- hospitals_2026_11_11 |>
  geocode(street = address, city = citytown, state = state, postalcode = zip_code,
          method = "census", lat = lat, long = lng)

# failures with ArcGIS
failed <- geo1 |>
  filter(is.na(lat)) |>
  select(-lat, -lng) |>
  geocode(street = address, city = citytown, state = state, postalcode = zip_code,
          method = "arcgis", lat = lat, long = lng)

# Combine and check
hospitals_geo <- bind_rows(filter(geo1, !is.na(lat)), failed)
sum(is.na(hospitals_geo$lat))   # how many still have no coordinates
```


### Verify nothing is changed (other than the new lat lng columns)
```{r}
new <- hospitals_geo |> select(-lat, -lng)

nrow(hospitals_2026_11_11) == nrow(new)
names(hospitals_2026_11_11) == names(new)

nrow(anti_join(hospitals_2026_11_11, new, by = names(hospitals_2026_11_11))) == 0
nrow(anti_join(new, hospitals_2026_11_11, by = names(hospitals_2026_11_11))) == 0

```


### Save into the data folder
```{r}
write_csv(hospitals_geo, "data/hospitals_2026-11-11.csv")
```
